product_name: CardioVital 360 — Regulated Preventive Cardiology & Metabolic Telehealth Platform
category: Regulated Healthcare Telehealth / Clinical Preventive Subscription
target_geo: United States (Active clinical licensure across 38 states)
verified_product_facts: Provides asynchronous clinical review by US board-certified cardiologists and lipidologists within 24 hours of biomarker upload.
Includes at-home advanced lipid & ApoB / Lp(a) blood biomarker test kit processed by CLIA-certified / CAP-accredited partner laboratories.
Integrates continuous biometrics from FDA-cleared wearable medical sensors (ECG, photoplethysmography, continuous glucose monitors).
HIPAA-compliant, SOC 2 Type II certified platform with end-to-end encrypted medical record storage.
Monthly direct subscription is $149.00/month (eligible for HSA/FSA reimbursement; insurance super-bills provided for out-of-network claims).
Customer lifetime retention benchmark in pilot cohort is 11.2 months with 68% gross margin after clinical delivery costs.
Physician consultation is required before any prescription lipid-lowering therapy or clinical protocol modification.
unverified_or_unknown_aspects: Exact commercial conversion rate of direct B2C paid Meta traffic vs employer wellness channel partnerships.
Long-term CAC payback variance across HSA/FSA debit card checkout vs standard credit card payments.
State-by-state regulatory variability for nurse practitioner autonomous prescribing in remaining 12 expansion states.
prohibited_and_disallowed_claims: Guaranteed 100% cure, reversal, or immunity from heart attacks, strokes, or coronary artery disease.
Direct-to-consumer promises to discontinue existing prescription statins or blood pressure medications without physician order.
Claiming FDA-cleared status for general platform algorithms where only physical partner sensors are FDA-cleared.
Using fabricated patient clinical outcome testimonials without signed HIPAA authorization and medical record verification.
human_approval_requirements: Chief Medical Officer / Clinical Director sign-off on all public diagnostic claims and biomarker interpretation copy.
Legal & Regulatory compliance approval on state telemedicine disclaimers and HSA/FSA marketing language.
Head of Growth approval on paid acquisition budget allocations above $25,000.
